prompt: In my opencode-coder setup, bd ready is failing with database errors. Give me a troubleshooting path, tell me what logging or environment variables to collect, and if this really looks like a plugin issue tell me what evidence to put into a GitHub bug report.
assertions: Recommends bd doctor and bd doctor --fix or bd bootstrap before manual deletion-style fixes
Distinguishes when to use a session export versus a diagnostics bundle
Helps classify whether the issue is a plugin issue versus a project issue
